objective: Evaluate retrieval on public reproducible data and a read-only snapshot of existing multimodal knowledge bases, with evidence-level labels, fair paired comparisons, failure retention, and actionable error analysis.

public_suite.corpus: All 5183 source abstracts; no positive-document-only corpus
public_suite.evaluation_queries: All 300 original development claims, treated as this project's held-out evaluation set
public_suite.development_queries: Original training claims with no normalized-query or source-document overlap with evaluation claims
public_suite.label_provenance: Original human document and sentence-rationale annotations; claim refutation is relevant evidence, not a negative retrieval label
public_suite.limits: English scientific claim retrieval; not a Chinese QA, media perception, clinical advice, or official leaderboard result

local_suite.source: Existing Tessmora knowledge bases and indexed evidence
local_suite.label_provenance: Source-grounded authored cases with explicit review provenance; generated captions/transcripts do not certify original-media perception
local_suite.data_policy: Snapshot and search only; never overwrite, reparse, ingest into, or re-embed the user's existing knowledge bases; private evidence stays in ignored local data

metrics.uncertainty: Paired query-cluster bootstrap; aggregate related query variants together; report per-family and per-modality results; do not infer run-to-run variance from one execution

rules: Freeze dataset, source and runtime configuration before evaluating held-out queries.
Keep raw failures and partial results in the task denominator; never replace them with successful retries.
Report component experiments separately from actual system API runs.
Use actual evidence from each mode's execution; no separate ordinary search pretending to measure Agent retrieval.
Report native-default mode behavior and resource consumption; any matched-budget experiment is separate and explicitly configured.
Keep document, evidence, and answer quality distinct; completion status is not a semantic score.
Do not change product defaults based on this evaluation alone.

deliverables: Versioned evidence-level dataset schema, validators, deterministic metrics and paired comparison
Resumable append-only run records with dataset/configuration/source fingerprints and real failure records
Public dataset importer with pinned download hashes, source attribution and reproducible splitting
Read-only private snapshot and source-grounded multimodal evaluation cases
Executed public and local retrieval evaluations with raw receipts, per-query results, coverage and uncertainty
Current-state findings and prioritized retrieval improvements, with explicit unverified boundaries
Regression tests, reproducible commands and completion audit
